All three lines. Nothing missing. But its HEADLINE is: '"REVOKE EXECUTE ... FROM anon, authenticated" DOES NOTHING. YOU MUST REVOKE FROM PUBLIC.' -- written in LC-1224 to correct the OPPOSITE error. articles.summary: The dominant defect in guardrail code: a check that confirms something is PRESENT without confirming it EXAMINED anything. Seven instances shipped in one afternoon across six parallel PRs, every one briefed explicitly to fail closed. Names the four recurring sub-shapes, the three instruments that actually catch them (a shared fail-closed contract, a mutation sweep with a canary, and the absence-check polarity rule), and the three places the class reappeared one layer up — in branch protection, in the reviewer itself, and in the resolver loop we have not yet built. Also carries the LC-1307 orchestration findings: delegation is two decisions not one, and four cheap "is this shipped" proxies all lie. ADDENDUM 2026-09-27: two more shapes — a test that asserts on its own setup instead of the outbound payload (entrance-test the request), and a provenance column as the only cheap proof that a multi-source reader is preferring what you think it prefers. ADDENDUM 2026-09-30: three more ways an assertion stops asserting — the vacuous-collection shape that is True when empty (5 of 7 disputed floor keys), a new fail-closed gate placed FIRST in a decision function silently short-circuiting every existing fixture that lacks its precondition (only a sweep catches this, never a revert-check), and in-code "equivalent mutant" comments being wrong 3 times out of 3. Plus the inverted defect class: a promotion gate deadlocked on a drift detector that is red by construction whenever promotion is warranted, latent for ~24h after each merge and re-armable by a mere workflow rename. ADDENDUM 2026-10-20: the copied Supabase Vault fetch in three GitHub workflows is fail-open. It rejects only the empty string and the literal None, so a PostgREST 4xx error body or a 502 page passes both guards and becomes WEBFLOW_API_TOKEN, surfacing hours later as an opaque Webflow 401. Fixed in run-testers-derive.yml (PR #1284) by checking the SHAPE (a bare JSON string) rather than the string value; run-deal-pill-sweep.yml and run-product-image-optimize.yml still carried the original shape.
